mechanism: direct re-derivation (Map.bind lowercases the same value again; masking holds only when the subdomain comparison is skipped)

target_operation.note: normalizes an explicitly supplied server name before subdomain comparison

deletion_method: replace the target line with an equal-indentation 'pass  # P-: target A deleted' (benchmark_real_v3.run_suite.delete_line); line numbers are preserved
test_scope: Werkzeug 2.2.3 released tests/ suite with 24 dev_server tests protocol-deselected; P+ applicable suite 816 passed, 24 deselected

candidate_universe.role: downstream re-derivation of the same normalization in Map.bind

universe_notes: U is the only later normalization of the value passed from bind_to_environ to Map.bind.
When subdomain is None, A's value is consumed by the subdomain comparison before Map.bind runs, so the downstream lowercasing cannot mask A; that is the exposing input.

When subdomain is supplied, the comparison block is skipped and the downstream lowercasing becomes the only consumer, which is the masking input.  This is a control prerequisite, not a candidate operation.
Completeness outside the declared U is not claimed.

inputs.note: A feeds the subdomain comparison. P+ computes an empty subdomain; P- warns and falls back to '<invalid>'.
The comparison block is skipped by the supplied subdomain. Map.bind lowercases again, so both variants agree; disabling that re-derivation exposes the deleted A.

not_claimed: All WSGI environments and host configurations
